before-start-and-pre-start-checks/1.context: Procedure 'BEFORE START / PREFLIGHT AND PRE-START CHECKS', step 'Corrective maintenance'
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/1.text: Confirm that all corrective maintenance necessary for flightworthiness is completed (Section 4.2).
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/1.note: RFM Section 4.1-4.2 (limitation-exceedance logbook entry, corrective maintenance) confirmed verbatim; step content is a plausible, non-contradicted summary of preflight checks.

before-start-and-pre-start-checks/2.context: Procedure 'BEFORE START / PREFLIGHT AND PRE-START CHECKS', step 'Exterior inspection'
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/2.text: Perform preflight inspection per RFM Section 4.2, including MGB and TGB oil levels, rotor blades, controls, cowls and leaks. If parked > 2 days or in case of doubt, open cowls.
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/2.note: RFM Section 4.1-4.2 (limitation-exceedance logbook entry, corrective maintenance) confirmed verbatim; step content is a plausible, non-contradicted summary of preflight checks.

before-start-and-pre-start-checks/3.context: Procedure 'BEFORE START / PREFLIGHT AND PRE-START CHECKS', step 'Weight and balance'
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/3.text: Check weight, CG and loading are within Section 2 limitations; record any exceedance as required by Section 4.1.
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/3.note: RFM Section 4.1-4.2 (limitation-exceedance logbook entry, corrective maintenance) confirmed verbatim; step content is a plausible, non-contradicted summary of preflight checks.

before-start-and-pre-start-checks/4.context: Procedure 'BEFORE START / PREFLIGHT AND PRE-START CHECKS', step 'Fuel tank drain (first flight)'
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/4.text: Before the first flight of the day and if OAT is at or above 0 °C, bleed the fuel tank at the drain point and confirm no leakage at the bleed valve.
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/4.note: RFM Section 4.1-4.2 (limitation-exceedance logbook entry, corrective maintenance) confirmed verbatim; step content is a plausible, non-contradicted summary of preflight checks.

before-start-and-pre-start-checks/8.context: Procedure 'BEFORE START / PREFLIGHT AND PRE-START CHECKS', step 'Rotor brake'
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/8.text: Rotor brake released, lever fully forward before engine start (Section 4.3).
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/8.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-start-and-pre-start-checks/8.note: RFM Section 4.1-4.2 (limitation-exceedance logbook entry, corrective maintenance) confirmed verbatim; step content is a plausible, non-contradicted summary of preflight checks.

engine-start-normal/0.context: Procedure 'ENGINE START – NORMAL PROCEDURE', step 'Fuel shut-off lever'
engine-start-normal/0.text: Forward, with guard in place. Confirm fuel system configured for start, fuel quantity sufficient and approved fuel per Section 2.5.
engine-start-normal/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-start-normal/0.note: RFM Section 4.3 (engine start sequence, Ng/t4/oil pressure monitoring) - narrative summary, no specific numeric claim contradicted by the RFM.

engine-start-normal/3.context: Procedure 'ENGINE START – NORMAL PROCEDURE', step 'Engine starting selector'
engine-start-normal/3.text: OFF, then select START according to RFM procedure, monitoring Ng, t4 and oil pressure.
engine-start-normal/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-start-normal/3.note: RFM Section 4.3 (engine start sequence, Ng/t4/oil pressure monitoring) - narrative summary, no specific numeric claim contradicted by the RFM.

engine-start-normal/4.context: Procedure 'ENGINE START – NORMAL PROCEDURE', step 'Start monitoring'
engine-start-normal/4.text: Monitor t4 and Ng during start; abort in case of abnormal rise or failure to accelerate as per limitations and emergency procedures.
engine-start-normal/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-start-normal/4.note: RFM Section 4.3 (engine start sequence, Ng/t4/oil pressure monitoring) - narrative summary, no specific numeric claim contradicted by the RFM.

engine-start-normal/6.context: Procedure 'ENGINE START – NORMAL PROCEDURE', step 'Before flight'
engine-start-normal/6.text: Complete remaining checks and progress to rotor engagement according to Section 4.3.
engine-start-normal/6.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-start-normal/6.note: RFM Section 4.3 (engine start sequence, Ng/t4/oil pressure monitoring) - narrative summary, no specific numeric claim contradicted by the RFM.

before-take-off-and-hover-check/0.context: Procedure 'BEFORE TAKE-OFF / HOVER CHECK', step 'Engine / rotor parameters'
before-take-off-and-hover-check/0.text: At ground idle and then flight condition, verify Ng, Nf/NR, Tq and t4 within normal operating ranges.
before-take-off-and-hover-check/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-take-off-and-hover-check/0.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.1 ('before takeoff, HIGE ~5ft, raise collective to confirm Ng can increase >=1% without exceeding max transient rating') confirmed verbatim.

before-take-off-and-hover-check/3.text: Establish a stable hover in HIGE at around 5 ft (1.5 m). Check attitude, power required and control response.
before-take-off-and-hover-check/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-take-off-and-hover-check/3.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.1 ('before takeoff, HIGE ~5ft, raise collective to confirm Ng can increase >=1% without exceeding max transient rating') confirmed verbatim.

before-take-off-and-hover-check/4.context: Procedure 'BEFORE TAKE-OFF / HOVER CHECK', step 'Engine power check (hover)'
before-take-off-and-hover-check/4.text: In HIGE at about 5 ft (1.5 m) before initiating forward flight, raise collective slightly to confirm that Ng can increase by at least 1 % without exceeding the maximum transient rating, and that the torque required is compatible with the take-off/landing environment and weight (Section 5.1).
before-take-off-and-hover-check/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
before-take-off-and-hover-check/4.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.1 ('before takeoff, HIGE ~5ft, raise collective to confirm Ng can increase >=1% without exceeding max transient rating') confirmed verbatim.

take-off-and-initial-climb/1.text: Accelerate towards Vy for best rate of climb. As a guide, Vy is approximately 65 kt IAS at sea level and decreases by about 1 kt for each 1000 ft of pressure altitude (≈ 120 km/h minus 2 km/h per 300 m).
take-off-and-initial-climb/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
take-off-and-initial-climb/1.note: RFM Section 4.5 §1 (Vy = 65kt at 0 Hp, -1kt/1000ft) confirmed verbatim; RFM SUP.28 §4 (HIGE to ~40kt then climb to clear ~20ft/6m at ~50kt/93km-h) confirmed verbatim (HV avoidance guidance).

take-off-and-initial-climb/2.context: Procedure 'TAKE-OFF AND INITIAL CLIMB', step 'HV avoidance (high gross weight)'
take-off-and-initial-climb/2.text: At high internal gross weight, use HIGE power to accelerate along the take-off path until IAS reaches about 40 kt, then begin the climb so as to clear roughly 20 ft (6 m) at around 50 kt (93 km/h), in line with the height–velocity diagram guidance (SUP.28).
take-off-and-initial-climb/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
take-off-and-initial-climb/2.note: RFM Section 4.5 §1 (Vy = 65kt at 0 Hp, -1kt/1000ft) confirmed verbatim; RFM SUP.28 §4 (HIGE to ~40kt then climb to clear ~20ft/6m at ~50kt/93km-h) confirmed verbatim (HV avoidance guidance).

take-off-and-initial-climb/3.context: Procedure 'TAKE-OFF AND INITIAL CLIMB', step 'Power management'
take-off-and-initial-climb/3.text: Maintain power within MCP or applicable take-off limits; monitor Tq and t4 margins.
take-off-and-initial-climb/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
take-off-and-initial-climb/3.note: RFM Section 4.5 §1 (Vy = 65kt at 0 Hp, -1kt/1000ft) confirmed verbatim; RFM SUP.28 §4 (HIGE to ~40kt then climb to clear ~20ft/6m at ~50kt/93km-h) confirmed verbatim (HV avoidance guidance).

climb/0.text: Above about 100 ft (30 m) AGL, establish a stable climb attitude with NR in the normal range and power within the recommended continuous or take-off ratings.
climb/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
climb/0.note: RFM Section 4.5 §1 CLIMB: 'Above 100ft(30m)...optimum climbing speed(Vy): IAS kt=65kt at 0Hp -(1kt/1000ft)' confirmed verbatim.

climb/1.text: For maximum climb performance, use Vy. As a guide, Vy ≈ 65 kt IAS at sea level, reducing by about 1 kt per 1000 ft of pressure altitude (≈ 120 km/h minus 2 km/h per 300 m). Adjust as required for obstacles and ATC.
climb/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
climb/1.note: RFM Section 4.5 §1 CLIMB: 'Above 100ft(30m)...optimum climbing speed(Vy): IAS kt=65kt at 0Hp -(1kt/1000ft)' confirmed verbatim.

climb/2.text: Monitor Tq and t4, keeping margins to transient and maximum limits. Adjust collective to keep a steady climb rate and avoid over-torque or over-temperature.
climb/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
climb/2.note: RFM Section 4.5 §1 CLIMB: 'Above 100ft(30m)...optimum climbing speed(Vy): IAS kt=65kt at 0Hp -(1kt/1000ft)' confirmed verbatim.

cruise-and-maneuvers/0.context: Procedure 'CRUISE FLIGHT AND MANEUVERS', step 'Cruise power and speed'
cruise-and-maneuvers/0.text: Establish cruise at a speed and torque setting compatible with fuel planning and limitations; use Section 5.1 tables as a reference.
cruise-and-maneuvers/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
cruise-and-maneuvers/0.note: RFM Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive fly-over: IAS~=110kt/204km-h for OAT+25C, >=1000ft AGL) confirmed verbatim.

cruise-and-maneuvers/1.context: Procedure 'CRUISE FLIGHT AND MANEUVERS', step 'Noise abatement (sensitive areas)'
cruise-and-maneuvers/1.text: Over noise-sensitive areas, the complementary manual recommends IAS ≈ 110 kt (204 km/h) for OAT +25 °C, adjusted slightly with temperature, and at least 1000 ft AGL where possible.
cruise-and-maneuvers/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
cruise-and-maneuvers/1.note: RFM Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive fly-over: IAS~=110kt/204km-h for OAT+25C, >=1000ft AGL) confirmed verbatim.

cruise-and-maneuvers/3.context: Procedure 'CRUISE FLIGHT AND MANEUVERS', step 'Turns and maneuvers'
cruise-and-maneuvers/3.text: Perform turns and basic maneuvers with smooth, coordinated control inputs, respecting bank angle, load factor and speed limitations given in Sections 2 and 4.5.
cruise-and-maneuvers/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
cruise-and-maneuvers/3.note: RFM Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive fly-over: IAS~=110kt/204km-h for OAT+25C, >=1000ft AGL) confirmed verbatim.

descent-and-approach/1.context: Procedure 'DESCENT AND APPROACH', step 'Speed and rate of descent'
descent-and-approach/1.text: Adjust cyclic and collective to achieve a stabilized descent profile. For noise-sensitive helipads, use about 60 kt (111 km/h) with a rate of descent close to 1000 ft/min; for approaches near sensitive areas but landing elsewhere, use Vy with around 500 ft/min as a reference.
descent-and-approach/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
descent-and-approach/1.note: RFM Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive approach/landing: 60kt/111km-h with ROD~1000ft/min; Vy with ROD~500ft/min near sensitive areas) confirmed verbatim.

descent-and-approach/2.context: Procedure 'DESCENT AND APPROACH', step 'Engine and rotor monitoring'
descent-and-approach/2.text: Monitor Tq, t4, Ng and NR; avoid prolonged low-power descents outside of the conditions allowed by the RFM, and respect all limitations.
descent-and-approach/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
descent-and-approach/2.note: RFM Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive approach/landing: 60kt/111km-h with ROD~1000ft/min; Vy with ROD~500ft/min near sensitive areas) confirmed verbatim.

descent-and-approach/3.context: Procedure 'DESCENT AND APPROACH', step 'Joining the approach'
descent-and-approach/3.text: Transition from en-route descent to the final approach by aligning with the landing site, confirming wind and obstacles and configuring lights and avionics as required. Plan to be around 100 ft (30 m) AGL when reducing towards a HIGE hover at roughly 5 ft (1.5 m).
descent-and-approach/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
descent-and-approach/3.note: RFM Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive approach/landing: 60kt/111km-h with ROD~1000ft/min; Vy with ROD~500ft/min near sensitive areas) confirmed verbatim.

approach-and-landing-normal/0.context: Procedure 'APPROACH AND LANDING – NORMAL', step 'Briefing and site assessment'
approach-and-landing-normal/0.text: Assess landing site, slope and wind; ensure slope and surface are within limitations (Section 2.3).
approach-and-landing-normal/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
approach-and-landing-normal/0.note: RFM Section 2.3 §5 (40kt/74km-h running landing limitation) and Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive approach speeds) confirmed verbatim.

approach-and-landing-normal/1.context: Procedure 'APPROACH AND LANDING – NORMAL', step 'Descent and approach speed'
approach-and-landing-normal/1.text: Plan a stabilized approach, managing airspeed and rate of descent within normal envelopes. As a guide, begin the approach around Vy (see climb section) and, in noise-sensitive areas, consider 60 kt (111 km/h) with a rate of descent close to 1000 ft/min or Vy with about 500 ft/min when approaching a helipad near sensitive areas.
approach-and-landing-normal/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
approach-and-landing-normal/1.note: RFM Section 2.3 §5 (40kt/74km-h running landing limitation) and Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive approach speeds) confirmed verbatim.

approach-and-landing-normal/3.text: Lower collective smoothly to touch down, maintaining attitude and heading with cyclic and pedals. For any planned running landing in normal operations, keep ground speed well below the 40 kt (74 km/h) running landing limitation (Section 2.3).
approach-and-landing-normal/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
approach-and-landing-normal/3.note: RFM Section 2.3 §5 (40kt/74km-h running landing limitation) and Section 9.18 (noise-sensitive approach speeds) confirmed verbatim.

shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/2.context: Procedure 'ENGINE SHUTDOWN AND SECURING THE HELICOPTER', step 'Rotor stop'
shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/2.text: Allow rotor to decelerate per limitations. If rotor brake is used, apply it below approximately 170 rpm in high wind conditions or below 140 rpm in normal conditions, as specified in Section 4.6. In high-wind operations, starting and stopping the rotor has been demonstrated up to about 40 kt (74 km/h) from any direction and 50 kt (93 km/h) headwind; for winds above roughly 40 kt, park the helicopter into wind and tie it down per Section 4.8.
shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/2.note: RFM Section 4.6 (rotor brake <=170rpm high wind / <=140rpm normal) and Section 4.8 (40kt/74km-h demonstrated any direction, 50kt/93km-h headwind, tie down above ~40kt) confirmed verbatim.

shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/4.context: Procedure 'ENGINE SHUTDOWN AND SECURING THE HELICOPTER', step 'Securing the helicopter'
shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/4.text: Install control locks or collective friction as required, fit covers and blade tie-downs per Section 4.2 guidance.
shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
shutdown-and-securing-helicopter/4.note: RFM Section 4.6 (rotor brake <=170rpm high wind / <=140rpm normal) and Section 4.8 (40kt/74km-h demonstrated any direction, 50kt/93km-h headwind, tie down above ~40kt) confirmed verbatim.

engine-health-check/0.context: Procedure 'ENGINE HEALTH CHECK PROCEDURE', step 'Flight condition'
engine-health-check/0.text: Stabilized level flight at a power rating close to MCP with Hp ≤ 12000 ft and heating/demisting OFF.
engine-health-check/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-health-check/0.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.2.1/3.2.3 (TRQ MARGIN positive+GOOD / T4 MARGIN negative+GOOD = satisfactory; +-35C correction threshold; VEMD-both-screens-failure IAS=100kt-2kt/1000ft law) confirmed verbatim. FIXED: the +-35 degC correction-applies condition was stated backwards (said >=35C, RFM says correction applies when margin is LESS than +35C) - corrected.

engine-health-check/1.context: Procedure 'ENGINE HEALTH CHECK PROCEDURE', step 'VEMD engine power check'
engine-health-check/1.text: Select the ENGINE POWER CHECK page on the VEMD and perform the check according to Section 5.1.
engine-health-check/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-health-check/1.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.2.1/3.2.3 (TRQ MARGIN positive+GOOD / T4 MARGIN negative+GOOD = satisfactory; +-35C correction threshold; VEMD-both-screens-failure IAS=100kt-2kt/1000ft law) confirmed verbatim. FIXED: the +-35 degC correction-applies condition was stated backwards (said >=35C, RFM says correction applies when margin is LESS than +35C) - corrected.

engine-health-check/2.context: Procedure 'ENGINE HEALTH CHECK PROCEDURE', step 'Evaluate margins (VEMD mode)'
engine-health-check/2.text: Check that TRQ MARGIN is positive and T4 MARGIN is negative with GOOD displayed; engine health check is satisfactory in this case.
engine-health-check/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-health-check/2.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.2.1/3.2.3 (TRQ MARGIN positive+GOOD / T4 MARGIN negative+GOOD = satisfactory; +-35C correction threshold; VEMD-both-screens-failure IAS=100kt-2kt/1000ft law) confirmed verbatim. FIXED: the +-35 degC correction-applies condition was stated backwards (said >=35C, RFM says correction applies when margin is LESS than +35C) - corrected.

engine-health-check/3.context: Procedure 'ENGINE HEALTH CHECK PROCEDURE', step 'Manual procedure (if required)'
engine-health-check/3.text: If VEMD result is not clearly satisfactory, record Tq, Ng, NR, Hp, OAT and t4 and apply the manual ENGINE POWER CHECK and t4 CHECK charts per RFM.
engine-health-check/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-health-check/3.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.2.1/3.2.3 (TRQ MARGIN positive+GOOD / T4 MARGIN negative+GOOD = satisfactory; +-35C correction threshold; VEMD-both-screens-failure IAS=100kt-2kt/1000ft law) confirmed verbatim. FIXED: the +-35 degC correction-applies condition was stated backwards (said >=35C, RFM says correction applies when margin is LESS than +35C) - corrected.

engine-health-check/4.context: Procedure 'ENGINE HEALTH CHECK PROCEDURE', step 'Corrected t4 margin'
engine-health-check/4.text: When necessary, compute corrected t4 margin using the Hp/OAT correction table. This correction only applies when the initial T4 margin is less than +35 °C; if the corrected margin is negative the result is acceptable. A T4 margin of +35 °C or more (before correction) means the engine condition is unsatisfactory outright — no correction to calculate.
engine-health-check/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-health-check/4.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.2.1/3.2.3 (TRQ MARGIN positive+GOOD / T4 MARGIN negative+GOOD = satisfactory; +-35C correction threshold; VEMD-both-screens-failure IAS=100kt-2kt/1000ft law) confirmed verbatim. FIXED: the +-35 degC correction-applies condition was stated backwards (said >=35C, RFM says correction applies when margin is LESS than +35C) - corrected.

engine-health-check/5.context: Procedure 'ENGINE HEALTH CHECK PROCEDURE', step 'VEMD screen failure (both screens)'
engine-health-check/5.text: If both VEMD screens fail, the maximum authorized power is the power required to maintain level flight while following the law IAS = 100 kt at 0 Hp minus 2 kt per 1000 ft (or 185 km/h minus 4 km/h per 300 m), as described in Section 3.5.
engine-health-check/5.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-health-check/5.note: RFM Section 5.1 §3.2.1/3.2.3 (TRQ MARGIN positive+GOOD / T4 MARGIN negative+GOOD = satisfactory; +-35C correction threshold; VEMD-both-screens-failure IAS=100kt-2kt/1000ft law) confirmed verbatim. FIXED: the +-35 degC correction-applies condition was stated backwards (said >=35C, RFM says correction applies when margin is LESS than +35C) - corrected.

cranking-procedure/3.text: Monitor t4, oil pressure and electrical parameters; abort if any abnormal indication occurs.
cranking-procedure/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
cranking-procedure/3.note: RFM Section 4.3/2.5 §5 (starter duty cycle, cranking purpose) - narrative summary, non-contradicted.

engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/5.text: Cyclic FORWARD for a slightly nose-up landing attitude (below 10°).
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/5.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/5.note: RFM Section 3.2 (cruise/hover-IGE/hover-OGE/over-water autorotation, in-flight relighting: Ng<17%, 1000ft/300m needed) confirmed verbatim in full, including the 170rpm rotor-brake threshold and the over-water <30kt/56km-h ditch speed.

engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/9.text: Collective full low pitch; apply the rotor brake below 170 rotor rpm.
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/9.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/9.note: RFM Section 3.2 (cruise/hover-IGE/hover-OGE/over-water autorotation, in-flight relighting: Ng<17%, 1000ft/300m needed) confirmed verbatim in full, including the 170rpm rotor-brake threshold and the over-water <30kt/56km-h ditch speed.

engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/10.text: Same procedure except items 10–12: head equally between wind and wave direction on final, ditch with minimum forward speed (IAS below 30 kt / 56 km/h) and minimum rate of descent. After touchdown: collective MAINTAIN, doors jettison handles PULL-UP, rotor brake APPLY; abandon once the rotor has stopped.
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/10.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/10.note: RFM Section 3.2 (cruise/hover-IGE/hover-OGE/over-water autorotation, in-flight relighting: Ng<17%, 1000ft/300m needed) confirmed verbatim in full, including the 170rpm rotor-brake threshold and the over-water <30kt/56km-h ditch speed.

engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/16.text: Engine starting selector — ON. The relighting sequence then runs automatically as soon as Ng is below 17 %.
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/16.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/16.note: RFM Section 3.2 (cruise/hover-IGE/hover-OGE/over-water autorotation, in-flight relighting: Ng<17%, 1000ft/300m needed) confirmed verbatim in full, including the 170rpm rotor-brake threshold and the over-water <30kt/56km-h ditch speed.

engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/17.text: [FUEL P] / [FUEL PUMP] — OFF. At least 1000 ft (300 m) are needed to complete the relighting procedure after a flame-out.
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/17.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
engine-flame-out-and-autorotation/17.note: RFM Section 3.2 (cruise/hover-IGE/hover-OGE/over-water autorotation, in-flight relighting: Ng<17%, 1000ft/300m needed) confirmed verbatim in full, including the 170rpm rotor-brake threshold and the over-water <30kt/56km-h ditch speed.

smoke-in-cabin/6.text: With [MASTER SW]/[EMER SW] actuated, or battery and generator off line, the VEMD goes off: apply the failure-of-both-screens procedure (Section 3.5 §1).
smoke-in-cabin/6.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
smoke-in-cabin/6.note: RFM Section 3.4 (source-identified GOV-stays-lit-until-next-shutdown note) confirmed verbatim.

engine-fire-and-governor-failures/0.context: Procedure 'ENGINE FIRE, GOVERNOR & FADEC FAILURES', step 'Engine fire — At start-up'
engine-fire-and-governor-failures/0.text: Engine starting selector OFF; emergency fuel shut-off handle AFT; [FUEL P]/[FUEL PUMP] OFF; [CRANK] press 10 s; rotor brake APPLY (≤ 170 rpm); [MASTER SW]/[EMER SW] OFF; evacuate and fight the fire from outside.

engine-fire-and-governor-failures/2.text: LAND IMMEDIATELY: collective LOWER, IAS Vy, autorotation procedure APPLY, emergency fuel shut-off handle AFT, [FUEL P] CHECK OFF, engine starting selector OFF. After landing: rotor brake APPLY (≤ 170 rpm), [MASTER SW]/[EMER SW] OFF, evacuate and fight the fire from outside.

engine-fire-and-governor-failures/3.context: Procedure 'ENGINE FIRE, GOVERNOR & FADEC FAILURES', step 'Major governor failure — In flight'
engine-fire-and-governor-failures/3.text: Emergency mode engages automatically and GOV lights. Check flight parameters. Avoid abrupt collective changes. Maintain Ng above 80 % below 20 000 ft (6096 m), above 85 % at or above 20 000 ft. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE.

transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/0.context: Procedure 'TRANSMISSION & HYDRAULIC FAILURES', step 'MGB low oil pressure (below 1 bar / 14.5 psi)'
transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/0.text: Reduce power; LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. If a safe landing is not possible, continue to the nearest suitable site at minimum power speed (Vy). 55 min of simulated flight at low power has been shown in bench tests.

transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/6.context: Procedure 'TRANSMISSION & HYDRAULIC FAILURES', step 'Hydraulic failure — In flight'
transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/6.text: Bank below 30°, avoid abrupt maneuvers, smoothly set IAS 40–60 KIAS (74–111 km/h), then hydraulic cut-off switch OFF. Do not let the twist grip leave FLIGHT as loads rise. LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/6.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025

transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/7.context: Procedure 'TRANSMISSION & HYDRAULIC FAILURES', step 'Hydraulic failure — Approach and landing'
transmission-and-hydraulic-failures/7.text: No hover or low-speed maneuvers. Over a clear flat area keep 40–60 KIAS, flat approach into wind, slow no-hover running landing at about 10 kt groundspeed (18.5 km/h). After landing collective LOCK, twist grip IDLE, shutdown.

electrical-and-fuel-alarms/2.context: Procedure 'ELECTRICAL & FUEL ALARMS', step 'DC generator off line'
electrical-and-fuel-alarms/2.text: Check U bus on the VEMD and [GENE] ON; check the GENE RESET breaker is not popped (30 α panel) and press [GENE RESET]. Case A/B: unnecessary equipment OFF, monitor U bus, land as soon as practicable, or continue if it recovers.

electrical-and-fuel-alarms/5.context: Procedure 'ELECTRICAL & FUEL ALARMS', step 'Fuel quantity low (≤ 48 kg / 106 lb)'
electrical-and-fuel-alarms/5.text: LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE; about 15 minutes of flight remain at MCP. Avoid large attitude changes that could cause a flame-out.

flight-control-and-misc-warnings/2.context: Procedure 'FLIGHT CONTROL HARDOVER & OTHER WARNINGS', step 'Hardover / servojam — In flight'
flight-control-and-misc-warnings/2.text: Set IAS 40–60 kt (74–111 km/h), sideslip if necessary; hydraulic cut-off switch OFF and apply the HYDR procedure; LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

flight-control-and-misc-warnings/3.context: Procedure 'FLIGHT CONTROL HARDOVER & OTHER WARNINGS', step 'Loads with no hydraulic pressure'
flight-control-and-misc-warnings/3.text: At high airspeed up to 20 daN (45 lbf) pull on the collective, 7–12 daN (16–27 lbf) push left and 2–4 daN (4.5–9 lbf) push forward on the cyclic.
flight-control-and-misc-warnings/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025

flight-control-and-misc-warnings/4.context: Procedure 'FLIGHT CONTROL HARDOVER & OTHER WARNINGS', step 'Bleed valve failure'
flight-control-and-misc-warnings/4.text: A flag on the FLI or 3-data page. If it does not clear at high power, maximum power is reduced (especially in the cold); if it does not reappear at low power, the engine may surge. Avoid abrupt power changes; GOV lights; land as soon as practicable.

tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.text: LAND IMMEDIATELY. Reduce twist grip to IDLE and increase collective as required to cushion touch-down as per Section 3.3 §1.1.
tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025

tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.context: Procedure 'TAIL ROTOR FAILURE – HANDLING AND LANDING', step 'Hover OGE (clear area)'
tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.text: Simultaneously reduce collective depending on available height, move cyclic forward to gain speed and maintain Vy or higher, adjusting collective to minimize sideslip (Section 3.3 §1.2).

tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.context: Procedure 'TAIL ROTOR FAILURE – HANDLING AND LANDING', step 'Cruise flight'
tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.text: Maintain Vy or higher and adjust collective to obtain minimum sideslip; LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE on a site suitable for autorotation (Section 3.3 §1.3).

tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.context: Procedure 'TAIL ROTOR FAILURE – HANDLING AND LANDING', step 'Autorotative landing'
tail-rotor-failure-handling-and-landing/.text: On a suitable area, perform an autorotative landing according to the ENGINE FLAME-OUT autorotation procedure (Section 3.2): maintain about Vy in the descent, flare at roughly 70 ft (21 m), level at around 20-25 ft (6-8 m) and cushion the touchdown with collective. Over water, aim to ditch with IAS below 30 kt (56 km/h) and minimum rate of descent, and keep the twist grip at IDLE during the descent.

hydraulic-failure-training/0.text: Trained instructor with recent experience; flight risk assessment beforehand. With hydraulics off: no hover or low-speed maneuvers, no bank above 30°. No passengers other than observers with training duties.

hydraulic-failure-training/0.note: RFM SUP.7 (crew/operating limitations, bank<30 deg no hover with hydraulics off, 2-step training procedure with 40-60KIAS safety speed, HYDR/gong/ACCU TST 3-second reset check) confirmed verbatim in full.

hydraulic-failure-training/4.context: Procedure 'HYDRAULIC FAILURE TRAINING', step 'Trainee, when HYDR lights'
hydraulic-failure-training/4.text: Bank below 30°, avoid abrupt maneuvers, set IAS between 40 and 60 KIAS (74–111 km/h).
hydraulic-failure-training/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
hydraulic-failure-training/4.note: RFM SUP.7 (crew/operating limitations, bank<30 deg no hover with hydraulics off, 2-step training procedure with 40-60KIAS safety speed, HYDR/gong/ACCU TST 3-second reset check) confirmed verbatim in full.

hydraulic-failure-training/5.context: Procedure 'HYDRAULIC FAILURE TRAINING', step 'Instructor, at safety speed'
hydraulic-failure-training/5.text: Reset [ACCU TST] to OFF. Check the light is off and HYDR out within 3 s. If it is not reset, hydraulic assistance cannot be restored.
hydraulic-failure-training/5.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025

hydraulic-failure-training/7.text: Check IAS between 40 and 60 KIAS. Keep bank below 30° and do not attempt hover or low-speed maneuvers; do not move the twist grip out of FLIGHT as loads increase.

hydraulic-failure-training/7.note: RFM SUP.7 (crew/operating limitations, bank<30 deg no hover with hydraulics off, 2-step training procedure with 40-60KIAS safety speed, HYDR/gong/ACCU TST 3-second reset check) confirmed verbatim in full.

dual-hydraulic-malfunctions/1.text: Jammed pedals or loss of pedal effectiveness. Below 20 kt (37 km/h) and near the ground a go-around may be impossible because of lost fin efficiency.

dual-hydraulic-malfunctions/2.text: Cyclic and collective — ADJUST to set IAS 70 kt (130 km/h) in level flight.
dual-hydraulic-malfunctions/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
dual-hydraulic-malfunctions/2.note: RFM SUP.23 (LIMIT maneuvering limit, loss of tail rotor control 70kt sequence, yaw servo slide-valve seizure hover/cruise sub-cases, HYD1/HYD2+SERVO bank<30/IAS<110kt, HYD2/tail-rotor-power-lost, SERVO alone, LIMIT alone) confirmed verbatim in full.
